alex: Running FP8 enablement smoke on H100+L40S matrix and hit a reproducible token mismatch on long-context test (ctx=4096). repro attached below.

maria: Ugh. Did this start after the kernel-election change?

alex: Yep. Rolled the new kernel-election heuristic last night (prefer_fp8_when_stable=true). Quick logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T02:12:00Z] model=redwood/open-7b-fp8 kernel=fp8_fast_conv dispatch=elect_fp8
[2026-03-18T02:12:00Z] kv_cache: evict_check triggered at step=512 threshold=0.15
[2026-03-18T02:12:01Z] ERROR: kv_cache_mismatch pos=1024 expected=0x3a4b got=0x1f22
```
Repro command I used: `./tools/perf/run_repro.sh --model open-7b-fp8 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --device h100 --config configs/pe-batch-fp8.yaml`

jordan: That kv mismatch looks like a cache-eviction ordering bug. We changed the batching heuristics to be more aggressive (microbatch coalescing). Could be a race between KV writes and eviction.

maria: Also note transformer-engine config we ship: `transformer_engine.enabled=true` and `transformer_engine.fp8.mode=dynamic`. If election picks an fp8 kernel that's optimized for packed KV layout, but eviction uses the old layout, mismatch happens.

alex: I profiled the two runs (before/after roll):
```
before: tokens/sec=980, p50=42ms, kernel=fp8_generic
after:  tokens/sec=1220, p50=36ms, kernel=fp8_fast_conv (elect_fp8)
```
So perf improved but correctness regressed on long tails.

perf-bot: CI perf check: fp8_fast_conv increases throughput by ~24% on H100 synthetic workload. Regression detection: correctness failed 1/5 long-context seeds. See /ci/artifacts/2123456789/

jordan: For a quick mitigation we can: 1) disable aggressive microbatch coalescing for seq>2048, or 2) make kv-evict hold the write lock until pending writes drain, or 3) force election to prefer fp8_generic for L40S until we audit layouts. Thoughts?

maria: Opt 1 is fastest to ship. Opt 2 is safer but will hurt throughput. Opt 3 is weird because it ties hardware to kernel preference — but might be acceptable as temporary gate.

alex: I'll open a short-lived canary that pins `kernel_policy=fp8_safe` for canary pool and run the full long-context regen. Putting a repro PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/6482

jordan: If people have time, try reproducing with `--trace-kv` to see whether writes are reordered. Command: `./tools/perf/run_repro.sh --model open-7b-fp8 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --device h100 --trace-kv > kv_trace.log`

maria: Noted. Also adding a small unit in runtime: after eviction, do a CRC check on rehydrated kv blocks under debug to catch mismatch early. We'll gate it behind `RUNTIME_DEBUG_KV_CRC=true`.

alex: Thanks — will run the canary overnight and post results in the morning. :coffee:
